title: Network Dashboard
hero_subtitle: A live, honest picture of what this device is talking to — nothing invented.
no_traffic: Quiet — no active hosts yet. Start a capture to see who this device talks to.
error_driver_missing_desc: Packet capture driver is not installed on this system.
error_permission_desc: Administrator privileges are required to open raw capture sockets.
error_backend_disconnected_desc: Unable to communicate with the NetPulse engine daemon.
error_adapter_lost_desc: Selected network interface is no longer available.

explanations.default_why: This card represents observed passive network telemetry on your local adapter.
explanations.default_action: No immediate action required. NetPulse continues listening passively.
explanations.dns_why: DNS queries resolve domain names (like github.com) to IP addresses. Higher latency usually happens when your configured DNS server responds slowly or over a congested Wi-Fi link.
explanations.dns_action: If web pages load slowly, consider switching to a fast DNS resolver (like 1.1.1.1 or 8.8.8.8) or run a diagnostic test in the Diagnostics tab.
explanations.tls_why: TLS handshakes establish encrypted connections to remote web servers. Spikes in TLS traffic indicate secure web browsing, streaming, or API requests.
explanations.tls_action: Your connection is encrypted and private. No action needed.
explanations.finding_why: This finding was flagged because the network behavior deviated from typical local baselines (e.g., unexpected ports, retry bursts, or protocol anomalies).
explanations.finding_action: Review the process owning this flow in the Apps tab, or inspect raw packet headers below.
explanations.notable_why: This notable event recorded a transient change in throughput, host connectivity, or response timing.
explanations.notable_action: Monitor your active connections if performance degrades.

direct_observation_desc: Direct wire capture. Telemetry grounded in reconstructed packet and flow headers.
evidence_outside_feed: Evidence {{kind}} #{{id}} is outside the active visible feed window.
no_matching_narratives_desc: No narrative items match your search or filter criteria.
no_traffic_desc: Start packet capture or select an active network adapter in the header bar to observe real-time network activity.
search_placeholder: Search processes (chrome, spotify), IPs (192.168), protocols (DNS, TLS)...
hero_standby_subtitle: Start packet capture in the header bar to observe network telemetry.
